status: compiled from metadata; identities provisional where noted
notes: Episode guide compiled on 2026-10-18 from public metadata, catalogue records and archived pages, after an adversarial verification round. Nobody watched any upload: every linked episode is at evidence 'metadata-checked', except Word of the Day 2023 episode 2, whose Hop! Vimeo URL has a recorded playback startup in data/hop-player-links.json ('playback-started'). No episode claims complete playback or a reference comparison.

Upload roles are identity claims from titles, labels, catalogue summaries and lengths. 'whole-candidate' means a programme-length upload matched to the episode, not a verified uncut broadcast; 'alternate-edition' is another edition of the same programme (a holiday version, a re-titled or shorter official copy, a licensed or subtitled international edition); 'part' is a numbered part or an incomplete single-file copy ('part' gives the uploader's part number when the parts are numbered); 'excerpt' is a segment or clip; 'possible' is a copy that probably is this episode but whose identity is unresolved. 'possible' copies never count toward coverage or totals. Licensed storefront listings (access 'licensed': hoopla, Apple TV, Prime Video) link to whole programmes behind an account, purchase or library card; they are not free uploads and not playback evidence. KET's page for Shalom Sesame 2010 programme 2 is a free PBS member-station stream limited to its broadcast area by a location check; it is linked as an alternate edition and is not a licensed listing.

original-1980s and coproduction-1998 are numbered by the IETV programme numbers in the National Library of Israel catalogue (records extracted in data/nli-ietv-catalogue.json); their codes read 'IETV no. N'. Seasons of original-1980s cover the number blocks 1–65, 66–130 and 131–198 (seasons[].firstNumber). archive.org S1–S3 and uploader 'season N episode M' labels follow broadcast order and are kept in each episode's altLabels, never as numbers; each altLabel repeats its source text and URL, and archive.org labels repeat their crosswalk match confidence. <143> (Sukkot) and <183> (Tu BiShvat) holiday versions are alternate editions of the same number. Titles are the NLI 245 $p titles: 60 season-1 programmes have the neutral 'רחוב סומסום <N>'; from <66> on the catalogue adds a subtitle, sometimes cut short in the catalogue itself (e.g. <75>); they are kept verbatim without the final period. NLI summaries are quoted in full from the catalogue. English titles (titleEn) are editorial translations, not catalogue titles. For the 70 co-production programmes and for original-series programmes whose NLI title names a story, titleEn translates that title. For 55 of the 60 neutral season-1 titles (all within 1–65), the story name comes from the programme's archive.org file label instead: storyHe quotes the label's story name verbatim, without the uploader's trailing year (<13>, <35>, <36>, <65>) or '(לא מלא)' ('incomplete', <46>), which describe the file rather than name the story and stay in sourceLabel and altLabels[].storyHe; a parenthesis that is part of the name, such as <38> '(פרק לפורים)', is kept; storySourceEn and storySourceHe name that label (the uploader's broadcast-order wording, not the catalogue title) and, where the crosswalk match is medium or low, its confidence, and titleEn translates it. <19>, <20>, <41>, <51> and <53> have no story name and no English title, because archive.org S1E7, S1E52 and S1E64 are unresolved among them.

The IETV-number to upload mappings (archive.org labels, YouTube copies, residual and ambiguous slots, match confidence) are recorded in the IETV crosswalk in data/classic-rechov-episode-audit.json. Each IETV episode lists that file and data/nli-ietv-catalogue.json as a repository-evidence source next to its NLI record URL. The extra episode field nli (NLI record id, IETV id, runtime, part) repeats the catalogue values for each number.

unidentified lists long uploads of a production (episode/unverified kind, at least 10 minutes, or a partial of at least 5 minutes) that are not matched to one episode, plus explicitly ambiguous candidates (for example archive.org S1E7, S1E52 and S1E64, and the 17 Hop! 2009 story files, 3–6-minute segments whose episodes are not identified), including a few long clips and compilations that may hold an unidentified programme (yt-VG3HsNMshXc, yt-TIPNuXPEcUY, web-6b6a7cd601, yt-WEXFzBnsp5U, yt-hy5t9WfsqpM, the two Shosha Goren uploads yt-RijAHYGqVeU and yt-bh939L3pYXw) and the short modern-2015 upload yt-rcjMhVLd1IE. archive.org S3E34 and S3E49 stay queued and are also linked as 'possible' copies of both <133> and <178>, whose order is unresolved. Songs, LP albums, other compilations and highlights, and short clips are not queued. classic-unassigned holds long classic uploads whose production is not established.

Formats: 'related-series' marks sesame-stories-2003 and coproduction-1998-arabic, which are counted outside the core Rechov Sumsum totals. Known gaps: records with production 'modern-other' (Hop! specials, songs, vocabulary segments, compilations) have no guide production; there is no holding queue for modern productions (four Arabic Luli TV 'full episode' uploads of unknown season and the 'months of the year' specials are in the uploads index only); an incomplete single-file copy is 'part' when the episode has no numbered part set (<46>, <99>, <117>, <198>) and 'excerpt' when a numbered set exists (<167>, <172>).

Totals: expectedTotal is set only where a primary or consistent source gives a lifetime count (198, 70, 20, 26, 40, 28, 15, 14, 11, 12). modern-2015 is contested (29 from reproduced Hop! press text against a separately named 4-episode 2014 accounting unit); homevideo-1999 and word-of-day-2023 have no documented lifetime total.

productions.nameHe: רחוב סומסום, הסדרה המקורית של הטלוויזיה החינוכית
productions.expectedTotalNoteEn: 198 programme numbers, <1> to <198>, are catalogued in the Israeli Educational Television holdings at the National Library of Israel; <183> has two records (a regular and a Tu BiShvat version) and counts once. A February 1986 IETV letter counts 195 programmes funded (a first series of 65 plus 130 more). The often repeated 65 and 'more than 200' conflict with the catalogue. Seasons follow the IETV number blocks 1–65, 66–130 and 131–198. The 130/131 season boundary is inferred, not catalogued: the NLI records carry no season; every matched archive.org S1, S2 and S3 file falls inside 1–65, 66–130 and 131–198 respectively; NLI tape references in the 35xx series begin at <131> ('3530/1-1'), while <105>–<106> carry 3409; the 1986 letter documents only the first 65. Community season and episode labels (archive.org S1–S3, uploader titles) follow broadcast order; they are kept as alternate labels, not as numbers.
productions.expectedTotalNoteHe: בקטלוג אוסף הטלוויזיה החינוכית בספרייה הלאומית רשומים 198 מספרי תכניות, <1> עד <198>; לתכנית <183> יש שתי רשומות (גרסה רגילה וגרסת ט"ו בשבט) והיא נספרת פעם אחת. מכתב של הטלוויזיה החינוכית מפברואר 1986 מונה 195 תכניות שמומנו (סדרה ראשונה של 65 ועוד 130). המספרים 65 ו'יותר מ־200' שחוזרים בכתבות סותרים את הקטלוג. העונות נקבעות לפי גושי המספרים 1–65, 66–130 ו־131–198. הגבול בין 130 ל־131 מוסק ואינו מקוטלג: ברשומות הספרייה אין עונה; כל קובץ מזוהה של עונות 1, 2 ו־3 בארכיון האינטרנט נופל בתוך 1–65, 66–130 ו־131–198 בהתאמה; הפניות הקלטות בסדרת 35xx בקטלוג מתחילות ב־<131> ('3530/1-1'), ואילו <105>–<106> נושאות 3409; המכתב מ־1986 מתעד רק את 65 הראשונות. תוויות עונה ופרק של מעלים (ארכיון האינטרנט, כותרות ביוטיוב) עוקבות אחרי סדר השידור ונשמרות כתוויות חלופיות, לא כמספרים.

episodes.noteHe: מטרת התכנית לפי הופ!: התחשבות בזולת. תקציר: נוח מקבל מחבריו מכונת תופים במתנה, אלא שהתלהבותו הופכת למטרד. הוא מתופף בעוצמה, כל הזמן. ברוש, צחי ואיבתיסאם מבקשים את התחשבותו. מתפתחת שיחה שמביאה אותם להבין שהתחשבות ההדדית היא שתביא אותם לפתרון. על בסיס הנחה זו הם מגיעים להסכם הוגן, אשר מתחשב ברצונו של נוח לתופף ובצרכים השונים של חבריו.

episodes.noteHe: מטרת התכנית לפי הופ!: לאנשים שונים יש נקודות מבט שונות; הכרה בנקודות של דמיון ושוני בין תרבויות. תקציר: נוח מאד רוצה לארגן למישהו מסיבת הפתעה. ברוש מעיד על עצמו שהוא מאד לא אוהב שמפתיעים אותו. נוח וצחי מחליטים לארגן מסיבת הפתעה לכבוד יום ההולדת של איבתיסאם, ואז עולה השאלה כיצד חוגגים ימי הולדת בתרבויות השונות? במה הדמיון ובמה השוני?
